dead_tree.notes: Bare salt-killed tree, exposed roots, snapped tapering limbs. Target height 3-5 m.

driftwood.notes: Bleached driftwood with split ends and worn branch stubs.

stranded_hull.notes: Open 5.2 m wooden hull, missing planks, visible ribs and rotten thwarts. No intact deck or hidden filler mesh.

crooked_dock_post.notes: Leaning timber mooring pile with frayed crown and rope wraps.

fallen_fishing_net.notes: Loose folded rope net with actual open cells, perimeter rope and four wooden floats; no alpha cutout.

window_shutters.notes: Painted timber frame, cross mullions, opaque salt-clouded glazing and two open shutters.

door_frame.notes: Weathered plank door with limewashed frame, cross bracing and iron latch.

canvas_awning.notes: Faded striped canvas, slight sag, scalloped edge and steel support arms. Double-sided valance geometry.

small_balcony.notes: Small timber platform, rusted iron balusters and two wall braces; no opaque railing filler.

exterior_stair.notes: Seven stone treads, timber stringers and two steel handrails; projects outward from the wall.

tavern_sign.notes: Hanging timber tavern sign perpendicular to wall, iron cantilever and original fish emblem. No font dependency.

wall_lantern.notes: Unlit iron wall lantern with opaque frosted glazing. No light node, emission or transparent sorting dependency.

chimney.notes: Limewashed wall chimney with exposed masonry courses, projecting crown and genuinely open flue.
